title: Connect Gmail, get customer replies drafted
learner: Owns a small bakery that takes custom orders by email. Customer questions pile up in Gmail between bakes, and they've never connected Claude to another tool.

connectors.name: Gmail
connectors.description: Draft replies, summarize threads, and search your inbox

connectors.name: Google Calendar
connectors.description: See your schedule and find open times

steps.text: Your customer emails live in Gmail. Claude can't see them until you connect it.
Connectors link Claude to tools you already use. None are connected yet.
Google lists what Claude may do. Read it, then allow.
Gmail is on for this chat. Now ask for the outcome, the way you'd brief an assistant.
Find customer emails from this week that are still waiting on a reply, and draft a response to each. Keep them short and friendly, like my past replies.

steps.text: Four customers are waiting on you. I saved a draft for each in Gmail, and nothing has been sent. Priya's wholesale question needs your price, so I left it blank instead of guessing.

items.subject: Re: Birthday cake for Saturday
items.preview: Hi Jenna! Saturday works. Your two-tier chocolate cake will be ready for pickup from 10 am…

items.subject: Re: Gluten-free cupcakes?
items.preview: Hi Marcus, we do! Our gluten-free cupcakes come out fresh every Thursday…

items.subject: Re: Wholesale for Café Lune
items.preview: Hi Priya, thanks for thinking of us! For four dozen a week, our price is ___ per dozen…

items.subject: Re: Order #1042 pickup
items.preview: Hi Tom, your order is all set. Pick it up any time after 2 pm on Friday…

steps.text: These are drafts. Nothing goes out until you open Gmail and send it.
Claude left the price blank instead of guessing. That part is your call.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.text: Connect the tool where your work already lives, then ask for an outcome you can check before anything goes out.
steps.prompt: Look through my Gmail for customers still waiting on a reply this week, and draft a response to each. Don't send anything.
